name: frozen-interface-context
text:
Add the keyword argument `summary_tokens: int | None = None` to `foe.Context` in
`python/foe/_contract.py`, as its last field, and have `to_dict` write it as the key
`summary_tokens` of the `context` block when it is set. The key bounds the size in tokens
of the summary a compaction writes. `docs/config.md` specifies the keys of the `context`
block and `docs/sdk.md` maps `foe.Context` to that block; both documents stay as they are.
The package keeps its type annotations complete and its tests passing.

Follow AGENTS.md. Run the checks it names. When you finish, or when you cannot, report your outcome.
